children: Stitch Fix, Inc. reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $1.35B and a diluted loss per share of ($0.09), narrowing its net loss to ($12.61M) from ($28.74M) a year earlier.
¹ Reported as “Revenue, net”. ² Reported as “Net loss”. ³ Reported as “Diluted loss per share attributable to common stockholders”.
Revenue rose 6.4% year over year to $1.348B, driven by a 7.8% increase in net revenue per active client.
Active clients declined 1.4% to about 2.277M, while average order value and items kept per Fix increased.
Company continued to emphasize its Fix and Freestyle channels and expanded owned private-label assortments to support margins.
Gross margin compressed by roughly 70 basis points, pressured by higher transportation costs and lower product margins.
Increased use of AI for personalization and inventory management; purchase commitments remain concentrated in the near term.
